newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: IBCA says it will give Lithuania rating this year.
newsitem.headline: IBCA says it will give Lithuania rating this year.

text.p: A delegation from the rating agency IBCA said on Friday that it would grant a rating to the Baltic state of Lithuania before Christmas.
"We will give Lithuania a rating before the end of the year, probably before Christmas," a member of the delegation told Reuters. He would add no further details.

Lithuania last summer became the first former Soviet republic to receive a rating when New Yrok-based ratings agency Moody's assiged its foreign currency debt a Ba2 rating and a Ba3 to its bank deposits.
New York-based Thomson BankWatch gave the country a sovereign risk rating of BB- in October.
